notes.title: Lizards Must Die 2 - The official announcement of the game 2025
notes.content:
IMPORTANT NEWS! Russ vs Lizards 2 will be released on March 27, 2025. That is, IN 10 DAYS!!! Add to the wishlist on  Steam and GET READY to slay LIZARDS with your friends! The game will be released fully at once without early access and demos, JUST THE WAY WE LIKE IT. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107800/RUSY_PROTIV_YASHHEROV_2/?l=russian

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/194ebd91b713542f634afa0a0c105cefcbaf5903.jpg

Right now the development is fully finished, Steam has already approved the project, so WE're POLISHING the GAME and are getting ready to PRESS the DESIRED RELEASE BUTTON. The game will also be available on VKPlay.

And now a little bit about what awaits you in the game.:

- The main campaign, which lasts from 3 to 3,000 hours (it all depends on the style of your game)
- Wave mode, where you can test your strength against hordes of lizards
- Cooperative for up to 4 people
- 4 unique playable characters: Vyacheslav Sergey's son, Vseslav the Magician, Viktor Korneplod and Mstislav Dubolyub. Each with its own unique style of play and abilities (from Lightning of Perun to Ass Kick Ability)
- A complete story - 9 full-fledged missions that reveal the story of the Great War of the Rus and Lizards and the Battle for Hyperborea.
- THE MOST BEAUTIFUL LOCATIONS. Russian villages, Lizard factories, streets of Hyperborea
- Different types of opponents. The cunning lizards not only run at you with sticks in their hands, but also use reptilian technologies - guns, bombs, cannons, as well as LIZARD MATHEMATICS.
- BOSSES! You'll have to work hard to defeat them.
- Additional game mechanics. You can shoot a cannon, ride a cart, ride or scratch the ears of DINOSAURS.
- Roffles and a bunch of DIALOGUES with tons of REFERENCES
- THE MOST POWERFUL Exclusive SOUNDTRACK in the FONK FOLK genre.
- GOIDA AND EGG CLAMP
- And much more

We look forward to presenting you the results of a year of work by our small team!

We are not waiting, but we are preparing, there are only 10 days left!

notes.title: Playable characters of the game "Lizards Must Die 2"
notes.content:
The Rus brothers! It's time to introduce you to the main characters of "Lizards Must Die 2"!

Choose your favorite fighter in the COMMENTS ːberdysh_rusː ːberdysh_rusː ːberdysh_rusː
So, here they are, the DEFENDERS OF THE LANDS OF THE RUS:
Drocheslav son of Sergey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5b0e8849e032629ec4c0ccfaca1a13c95595f568.jpg
Drocheslav son of Sergey is a mighty warrior, son of Sergey and grandson of Perun, god of Thunder. Drocheslav is a testosterone rock that protects Land of the Rus from enemies all his life. Slow, but powerful and heavy, like a hammer blow to the balls.
He skillfully wields a two-handed axe, inflicts damage on the area and scatters lizards like babies. His patron is the mighty Perun, so Drocheslav can hit enemies not only with a axe swing, but also with lightningballs and thunder strikes.
Vseslav the Sorcerer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/0a6baf28e0c42452d5ddef79c0a11b7da29ad815.jpg
Vseslav the Sorcerer - Thomas Shelby, Sigma, Mafia. A sharp and impudent high-speed rus, he always speaks first and thinks later, so immediately, after he thinks, he is forced to fight. Vseslav is a Sorcerer, a descendant of an ancient Hyperborean princely family. He inherited a magic blade that can create copies of itself from his grandfather , and now destroys lizards with his dexterity and charisma.
Viktor Korneplod
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/6dba5a5f5a44478b61db6724bd08f5a3209fc74f.jpg
Viktor Korneplod is a hermit magus and an ancient Russian eco-activist. The damn lizards are polluting the lands of the Rus, and now Victor has a reason to come out of the thicket and unleash the fury of his staff on the heads of his enemies. The forces of nature, wind and earth are what the lizards who dare to desecrate the sacred forests will face. He prefers philosophical arguments with a badger, hedgehog or squirrel to the company of people.
 Mstislav the Oaklover
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5d8369ee242ffd855af5d57d9ee80dc6c0f86e78.jpg
Mstislav the Oaklover - Oaklover was a nickname his parents gave him, though we will never know why, because Mstislav is an orphan. Fleeing from bears as a child, Mstislav hit his head on a rock and fell into Lake Baikal. After swimming in it for three days, he gained superpowers, but you have to pay for everything, so Mstislav is a bit slow-witted. Okay, to be honest, Mstislav is just dumb. Loves kvass. Doesn't like bears.

Add the game to whishlist, it will be released THIS spring.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107800/RUSY_PROTIV_YASHHEROV_2/

notes.content:
